learning_outcomes.text: Should have knowledge about Operations Research and optimization concepts and content.
Should have recognized general optimization concepts and principles.
Should have gained skills in writing mathematical models for optimization problems and solving these models.
Should have understood the basic principles, assumptions, and application areas of Linear Programming.
Should know the fundamentals and methods of nonlinear programming.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Operations Research and Optimization
Fundamentals of optimization: Feasibility and optimality, convexity, general optimization algorithm
Fundamentals of optimization: speed of convergence, Taylor Series, Newton Method
Linear Programming (LP): Representation of linear constraints, geometry of the LP
Linear Programming (DP): Advanced topics in DP
Linear Programming (DP): Advanced topics in DP
Nonlinear Programming: Constrained and unconstrained optimization
bibliography: Griva I., Nash S.G., Sofer A., 2009. Linear and Nonlinear Optimization, SIAM.
